## For LLMs and tooling

The entire Sciris API — every public function and class, with its signature, summary, and aliases — is available as a single machine-readable file, following the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention:

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): the compact index (~45 kB)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the same, plus a usage example for each function (~90 kB)
- [api.json](api.json): the same data as structured JSON, for programmatic use

All three files are generated from the source (`cd docs && python make_api.py`) and are verified in CI, so they never drift from the current version of Sciris.
